compiled_state.title: [brainstorm]: Cross-epic scan executed inline by orchestrator instead of dispatching haiku classifier sub-agents -> SKIPPED signal at approval gate
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per skills/brainstorm/prompts/cross-epic-scan.md, Step 2.25 dispatches dso:cross-epic-interaction-classifier (haiku tier) sub-agents in batches of 20 to classify interactions between the new epic and all open/in-progress epics. The approval gate (phases/approval-gate.md) HARD-GATE requires sub-agent dispatch and records inline triage as SKIPPED.

#### Actual Behavior

The brainstorm orchestrator scanned the ticket list-epics output inline and pattern-matched overlaps without dispatching any sub-agents. Recorded as cross_epic=SKIPPED:inline-triage-only at the approval gate. User flagged this as a recurring problem.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* Skill: /dso:brainstorm
* Phase: Phase 2 Step 2.25 (Cross-Epic Interaction Scan)
* Contract: skills/brainstorm/prompts/cross-epic-scan.md
* Gate: phases/approval-gate.md HARD-GATE (SCRUTINY line)
